user.title: Connect Verkada
user.description: Connect your Command organization. API keys are stored on Home Assistant, never in GitHub. After setup, use the integration options to choose cameras and enable LPR or Helix.

data_description.name: Name shown in the HA sidebar.
data_description.region: Use the region where your Command organization was created.
data_description.org_id: The UUID of your Verkada Command organization.
data_description.api_key: A top-level key with Camera device read permission. Enable alerts, thumbnails, LPR and Helix permissions for the features you use.
data_description.streaming_api_key: Use a separate key with live/history streaming permission if required. Leave blank to use the API key above.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Verkada credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter valid credentials for the same organization. API keys are entered again; blank streaming key uses the main key.

init.title: Verkada options
init.description: Leave camera selection empty to include all cameras. Only select actual LPR-enabled cameras for LPR polling. Helix requires an existing event type UID; the plate attribute is the exact field name in your custom schema.

data_description.camera_ids: Empty includes all cameras, including newly discovered cameras.
data_description.poll_interval: 30–900 seconds. Cloud event polling and camera health share this interval.
data_description.alerts: Enable if the API key has camera alert read permission. Webhooks work independently.
data_description.lpr_camera_ids: Select only cameras already enabled for LPR in Command. Loads the last 24 hours once; plate sensors are created only for selected plate sources.
data_description.helix_event_type: Leave blank to disable Helix polling.
data_description.helix_plate_attribute: Exact custom attribute containing the plate number, such as license_plate.
data_description.webhook_secret: Optional. At least 16 characters; configure the exact same secret in Command. Blank disables webhooks.
data_description.history_days: 1–30 days, capped at 1,000 events. This does not change Verkada video retention.
data_description.high_resolution: Uses more bandwidth; affects newly opened streams.
data_description.helix_camera_ids: Cameras whose existing Helix events contain plate data. Adds plate sensors without native LPR polling.
data_description.live_codec: HEVC uses native camera video. H.264 improves browser compatibility but requires Verkada conversion.

error.short_secret: Use at least 16 characters for the shared secret.
